Comment:
Highways 101, 17, and 280 are currently experiencing traffic volumes beyond road capacity. How will this project affect traffic flows/congestion on these roads? Will the project increase Vehicle Miles Traveled (VMT) in San Jose?

The range of projects planned for the three-year Community Development Block Grant program will have a negligible impact on traffic volumes or circulation patterns in San Jose. No proposed project involves the widening, extending, or closing of any streets. The CDBG program will not alter existing residential densities or promote residential growth in currently undeveloped areas.
